posts.title: Avoiding the Lambda Doom Loop
posts.description: Heads up serverless developers! A recent change in the Lambda sandbox environment changes how timeouts are handled, potentially causing your function to enter a permanent doom loop. This post will explain the change, how to spot it, and how to avoid the doom loop.
